title: Diviner: Agentic RCA with Human-Governed Adaptation for Large-Scale Infrastructure
abstract: arXiv:2610.21281v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Root-cause analysis (RCA) in large-scale distributed systems is challenging because a single symptom can cross service, data, configuration, compute, and organizational boundaries. Responders must assemble incomplete evidence and coordinate experts who hold different parts of the causal path. Generic language-model agents do not solve this problem through tool access alone: they can use stale or mistimed context, interpret failed queries as absent symptoms, report unsupported system state, and overload observability services designed for human-paced use.   We present Diviner (Domain-Informed Verifiable Incident Navigation through Evidence and Review), an agentic RCA system operating at Meta and organized around a four-stage reliability lifecycle. translated_title: Diviner：面向大规模基础设施、具备人类治理自适应机制的智能体根因分析系统
translated_abstract: 大规模分布式系统中的根因分析（RCA）极具挑战性，因为单一症状可能跨越服务、数据、配置、计算和组织边界。应急响应人员必须拼凑不完整的证据，并协调掌握因果路径不同环节的专家。通用的语言模型智能体无法仅凭工具访问来解决这一问题：它们可能使用过时或时机不当的上下文，将查询失败误判为症状缺失，报告缺乏依据的系统状态，并使为人类使用节奏设计的可观测性服务过载。我们提出了Diviner（通过证据与审查实现领域知识驱动的可验证故障导航），这是一个在Meta实际运行的智能体化根因分析系统，围绕四阶段可靠性生命周期组织。Encode（编码）阶段将大规模经过审查的故障案例库与服务所有者的专业知识相结合，生成有范围限定、带版本管理的能力、工作流、类型化工具以及故障知识图谱。Execute（执行）阶段使用自适应……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了在Meta实际部署的智能体根因分析系统Diviner，其核心创新在于围绕四阶段可靠性生命周期，将经过审查的故障案例库与服务所有者专业知识编码为带版本控制的能力、工作流、类型化工具和故障知识图谱，从而克服通用语言模型智能体在跨服务、数据、配置与组织边界进行根因分析时上下文过时、误判症状和滥用可观测性服务的局限。
en_tdlr: Diviner is an agentic root-cause analysis system deployed at Meta whose key innovation is a four-stage reliability lifecycle that encodes reviewed incident corpora and service-owner expertise into scoped, versioned skills, workflows, typed tools, and an incident knowledge graph, addressing the limitations of generic LLM agents such as stale context, misinterpreting failed queries, and overloading human-paced observability services.
